items.title: Deutsche Bank Switches On Bitcoin Custody for Paying Clients
items.summary: Germany's largest lender now holds bitcoin, ether and three stablecoins for institutional and corporate clients in Europe, but it has not named any customers or disclosed fees. This post Deutsche Bank Switches On Bitcoin Custody for Paying Clients first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Bitcoin 'ripe for a squeeze' as options traders raise odds of sub-$70,000 Christmas
items.summary: Bitcoin trades below $74,000 on Wednesday after five weekly losses, with Derive pricing 31% odds of a sub-$70,000 Christmas.

items.title: Bitcoin Core discloses three patched security flaws, including high-severity mining bug
items.summary: Bitcoin Core disclosed three previously patched security vulnerabilities, including a high-severity bug affecting block template creation.

items.title: Bitcoin sits out stock rebound as ETF outflows extend to fourth day
items.summary: Bitcoin held steady near $74,000 as Tuesday's hot inflation figure lifted the odds on a U.S. interest-rate increase to around 90%. ETF outflows extended to a fourth day and liquidations jumped.

items.title: Bitcoin short-term holders send 47K BTC to exchanges at a loss
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low of $72,670 after slipping below short-term holders' average cost basis of about $75,700, according to CryptoQuant.
